name: streak-seed
description: Headless MVP for StreakKeeper: create a habit, log today's completion (idempotent), and read current/longest streak + at-risk — all derived from one server-side UTC day cutoff.

scripts.typecheck: for f in $(find src scripts -type f \( -name '*.js' -o -name '*.mjs' \)); do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done; echo "typecheck ok"
scripts.qa:mvp: npm run typecheck && npm run test
